notes.title: Happy New Year!!!
notes.content:
Hello guys :D
Long time no see.

We already in the last day of 2018. And it's been a year for Lobster Empire. Many things happened in 2018 but we learned a lot of things too. But we realize that if we want to be better on making a game, we need all of you guys. 

We know that we still do something not good in Lobster Empire. But then you guys help us to make it better. From that, we know that we can go further. That's why we need your honest review about our game. We need all of your feedback, suggestion, your thought, and anything like that about our game so we can be better. So please tell us everything in your mind about our game, about Lobster Empire, on review section and we'll learn from it. We'll try our best to be better so you guys will enjoy playing our game.

Right now, we are developing a simulation game called "Age of Hydroponics" and "Aquaculture Land". 

For Age of Hydroponics, it's a hydroponics farm simulation game where you manage your farm business in an urban area. And for Aquaculture Land, Aquaculture Land is an aquafarming simulation game. In this game, you will act as a businessman that runs a freshwater fish farm. You will manage all things related to fisheries.

For Age of Hydroponics, because we still don't have steam store page for it, you can follow our Twitter account : https://twitter.com/MaulidanGames for the newest update about the development. Here some sneak peek from Age of Hydroponics :

For Aquaculture Land, because we already have steam store page for it, you can check it here : https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/
You can wishlist it so will know when we post some new update about it. Here some sneak peek from Aquaculture Land :

notes.title: ⚠ Major Updates, Added Content, and New Trailer Released! version 1.0.2a
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thanks to all players and all those who have helped us to make the final version perfect. The update process of this game is quite time consuming but we are very grateful for your patience to wait.

In this new patch we have made some changes and improvements:
1. All bugs (both major and minor) that occurred in the first version have been fixed.
2. New features: event in the voyage, which will determine the fate of boats and voyages. All the attributes of lobstermen will also play a major role in this feature. It may feel heavy in the beginning, but with a good lobstermen team management, everything will be okay.
3. New features: Game system on hatchery updated. Now the juvenile lobster release will have a direct impact on the red zone reforestation.
4. New features: some new upgrade items have been added and have big impact especially in Era 2 and Era 3.
5. Sequence of the quest has been updated. There are several new quests added. Some quests that are seems monotonous or too difficult have been omitted.
6. All difficulties have been rebalanced, some of which were raised while some others downgraded.

By the way, we also upload a new trailers and some new screenshots. Feel free to take a look at the store page: http://store.steampowered.com/app/665960/Lobster_Empire/

Meet our Calico!!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IlbRByy.jpg[/img]

Thanks, guys. Hopefully in 2018 we all can get better achievements of all things.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lEmA8su.gif[/img]

notes.title: ⚠ Thank you so much for all the patience towards Lobster Empire! We love you, guys!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xEeFYzL.gif[/img]

Thank you very much to all who have been waiting for our game. To be honest we were surprised to see such great enthusiasm for the Lobster Empire. We were very fortunate to have the lobster theme and the many people who waited for it.

Let us tell you about the beginning why we have the theme of lobsters. Lobster Empire originates from our interest in the lobster business owned by our country's marine minister. (Lately she's on the rise in our country, lol). With previous experience in developing the simulation management genre, we finally decided to try this lobster theme.

Precisely in the April, we showed the first mockup of Lobster Empire at international game developers group. The first input we get was from someone whose childhood is in direct contact with the lobster industry. So we discuss and consult online with him.

Since then we started doing in-depth research on lobster, especially American Lobster. We also began to explore the science of game design and learn from the successful games, such as Game Dev Tycoon and Empire TV Tycoon. Although we have released two games previously, but one thing we realize that our biggest shortcoming is in the complexity that is in line with the standards of simulation players in Steam.

For Lobster Empire, we refer to a special book specializing in lobsters. As much as possible we include variables that are true to reality. It's fortunate that the lobster industry is among the largest in the U.S., so we have no trouble getting a lot of content around it.

Our biggest challenge is whether the feature we created is interesting enough. A few months we do iteration, looking for the best design formula, forced to throw away the features that have been made, to perform regression tests repeatedly in order to find one of the most crucial thing in the game, fun and challenging.

We are also proud to have one of the best artist teams with us. One of our artist successfully overcame his color blindness while also leading all the interns to create lots of arts together with our diligent environment artist. They provide the best in every pixel. We thank you a lot for those who appreciate the aesthetics of Lobster Empire.

The highlight of the problem is delay issues. We recognize our miss for inactivity in providing updates about development issues that result in delay, lot of delays. We realize that indie games faithful community loves openness. In the future we will practice good communication and hopefully build better community around our games. 

We hope you are still together in our next products. Can we ask you to become our follower? :)

Lastly, Please enjoy our games!

Note: If you have input and feedback about Lobster Empire, we are happy to receive it via contact@maulidangames.com Starting this moment we will try to be active in communicating about development and other things.
